A Chinese leaker with some track record has posted images of claimed circuit diagrams of the upcoming iPhone 18 Pro models.

These suggest that the new A20 Pro chip may have seven GPU cores – one more than its predecessor – and a faster memory interface …

The images posted by Weibo user Fried White Rice are not of the A20 Pro chip itself, but rather diagrams of where the chip will be attached to the underlying circuit board. From this, they’re making inferences about the power and architecture of the new chip, drawing two main conclusions about likely improvements.

First, the diagrams point to six CPU cores in the same configuration as last year’s model: two high-performance ones and four efficiency cores. However, it appears that the cache memory for the efficiency cores has been increased.

Trying to determine the number of GPU cores from the limited information provided by the solder diagrams is tricky, with six, seven and eight cores all possibilities. However, they conclude that seven cores is the most likely.

Fixed Focus Digital recently suggested that the A20 Pro chip will be 18% faster than its predecessor with 30% better power efficiency.

9to5Mac’s Take

The Weibo account does have a certain amount of credibility, but this kind of indirect inference is very much a dark art. While the conclusions drawn are indeed plausible, they shouldn’t be viewed as anything more than informed guesses.
